notes: - **This is a feature release,** so sites offer it in **Admin → Updates** and wait for someone to click **Update**. Before updating a site with a customised `.htaccess`, see the server rule change below. - **New Blog plugin** (Admin → Plugins → Blog): posts with a featured image, categories, tags, author and date, like WordPress. - **Schedule posts:** pick a future publish date and the post goes live by itself at that time. Scheduled and draft posts are hidden from visitors but can be previewed while logged in. - A **Blog posts** section for the main blog list (category links, page numbers, category, tag and author archives) or a "latest posts" strip on any page. - Post pages at `/blog/` with breadcrumbs, tags, newer/older links, `BlogPosting` structured data and a share image; an RSS feed at `/blog/feed`. - The post editor has the Accessibility check, and its text box has an **Image** button for photos in the post. - Claude can write and schedule posts through the connector. - **New field types for plugins:** `datetime`, `multiselect` (checkboxes) and `tags`, plus typing suggestions (`suggest`) and options worked out on demand. - **New collection options:** readable item addresses (`clean_ids`), `before_save`, `describe`, `subroutes`, `a11y_check` and `help`. Collection items can now have their own SEO title. - Rich text keeps images (`` from `uploads/` or `https://`, with their alt text). The Accessibility check flags images in text without a description. - New icons: `pen` and `user`. - `tests/blog.sh` (in the smoke CI job); the AAA audit now covers the blog list, archives, a post and the post editor. - **Bilingual sites (optional), e.g. English and Welsh.** Switch on in Admin → Settings → Languages. Off by default, so existing sites don't change. - The second language lives under `/cy/` (or `/en/` on a Welsh-first site). Pages can have their own address in each language (`/cy/cysylltu`). - The page editor, vehicle editor and Settings show a translation box under every text field. Blank boxes fall back to the main language. The Pages list shows how much of each page is translated. - A language link in the top bar of every theme. ``, `hreflang` and `og:locale` are set for each language. Fixed wording in themes, sections, forms, bench.js and the Car Stock, Van Stock and Blog plugins goes through `t()`. Blog dates show Welsh month names, and blog categories get a Welsh translation (Settings → Blog), line by line. - Welsh wording ships in `core/lang/cy.php` and the plugins' `lang/cy.php`. It's a first draft: have it checked by a Welsh speaker. `custom/lang/cy.php` overrides any of it for one site. - The Claude connector can read and write translations (`_t`). It merges them per language and marks translatable fields in `get_schema`. - Enquiry forms on Welsh pages send `language: Welsh` with the message. - Page addresses made from Welsh titles keep their letters: "Cysylltu â ni" becomes `cysylltu-a-ni`. Language codes such as `cy` can't be used as page addresses. - **Server rule change:** the short-link rewrite in `.htaccess` and `router.php` now allows three-part addresses (`/cy/ceir/`). Sites with a customised `.htaccess` get the new file as `.htaccess.new`. Copy the `RewriteRule … {0,2}` line across, or Welsh vehicle pages return 404 on Apache. - **Themes copied into `custom/themes/`** keep working. To get the language link and the right `` on Welsh pages, add `bench_language_switcher()` and `bench_html_lang()` (see `themes/trade/layout.php`). - New `tests/i18n.sh` (bilingual sites, in the CI smoke job). `tests/blog.sh` covers a Welsh blog. `tests/connector.sh` covers translations, and the AAA audit has two bilingual runs.
